text_simplified: The Prophet ﷺ guided us that the best gift a parent can give their child is good *adab* (manners): «Mā naḥala wālidun waladan min naḥlin afḍala min adabin ḥasan», and that disciplining a child is better than charity, and that the *tarbiyah* (upbringing) of daughters and *ihsan* (excellence) toward them is a shield from the Fire.

review_defects.arabic: «ما نحل والدٌ ولداً أفضل من أدب حسن» — فضل تأديب الأبناء
review_defects.english: «Mā naḥala wālidun waladan afḍala min adabin ḥasan» – Faḍl Taʼdīb al-Abnāʼ
review_defects.why: The English title is a transliteration of the Arabic, not a translation. It does not convey the meaning of the hadith or the subtitle 'The Virtue of Disciplining Children' to an English reader.

review_defects.arabic: «ما نحل والدٌ ولداً من نحلٍ أفضل من أدب حسن»
review_defects.english: «Mā naḥala wālidun waladan min naḥlin afḍala min adabin ḥasan»
